readback.en: Let $K$ be any number field with its field and finite-dimensional $\mathbb Q$-vector-space structures, $I$ any ideal of $\mathcal O_K$, $h_I$ a proof that $I\ne(0)$, and $P$ a point of the height-one spectrum of $\mathcal O_K$, represented by a nonzero prime ideal $\mathfrak p_P$. Then $P$ belongs to $\operatorname{primeSupport}(h_I)$, the finite set obtained from the nonzero prime divisors of $I$, if and only if $\mathfrak p_P$ divides $I$ as an ideal. Divisibility means that $I=\mathfrak p_PJ$ for some ideal $J$. For the unit ideal $I$, neither condition holds for any such $P$.

theorem log_absNorm_eq_finsum {I : Ideal (𝓞 K)} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    Real.log (Ideal.absNorm I) = ∑ᶠ P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K),
      (multiplicity P.asIdeal I : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm P.asIdeal) := by
  classical
  set s := primeSupport hI
  have hzero : ∀ P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K), P ∉ s → multiplicity P.asIdeal I = 0 := by
    intro P hP
    exact multiplicity_eq_zero.mpr (by rwa [mem_primeSupport] at hP)
  have hprod : I = ∏ P ∈ s, P.asIdeal ^ multiplicity P.asIdeal I := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.finprod_heightOneSpectrum_pow_multiplicity hI]
    refine finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ fun P hP => ?_
    by_contra h
    exact hP (show P.asIdeal ^ multiplicity P.asIdeal I = 1 by rw [hzero P h, pow_zero])
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := s)]
  · conv_lhs => rw [hprod]
    rw [map_prod, Nat.cast_prod, Real.log_prod]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun P _ => ?_
      rw [map_pow, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
    · intro P _
      rw [map_pow, Nat.cast_pow]
      exact pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast (NumberField.HeightOneSpectrum.one_lt_absNorm P).ne_bot)
  · intro P hP
    by_contra h
    exact hP (by simp [hzero P h])

Here $P$ ranges over all nonzero prime ideals $\mathfrak p_P$ of $\mathcal O_K$, $N(J)=|\mathcal O_K/J|$ is the absolute ideal norm viewed as a real number inside the real natural logarithm, and $v_P(I)$ is the natural-number multiplicity of $\mathfrak p_P$ in $I$, also viewed as real. The sum is the algebraic finite-support sum over this entire spectrum, not a limit of partial sums. The unit ideal is included: its norm is $1$ and all these multiplicities are zero.

readback.en: Let $F,L$ be arbitrary number fields, each with its field and finite-dimensional $\mathbb Q$-vector-space structures, and equip $L$ with an $F$-algebra structure. Write $\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L$ for the rings of integers, $\mathfrak D=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ for the relative different ideal, $d=[L:\mathbb Q]$ for the dimension of the full field $L$, $N(J)=|\mathcal O_L/J|$ for the absolute norm of an ideal of $\mathcal O_L$, and $v_P(\mathfrak D)$ for the natural-number multiplicity of a nonzero prime ideal $P$ in $\mathfrak D$. For every point $P$ of the height-one spectrum of $\mathcal O_L$, identified with its nonzero prime ideal, define the real number $\operatorname{diffTerm}(F,L,P)=v_P(\mathfrak D)\log N(P)/d$, using real casts of the natural-number multiplicity, norm, and dimension. This is a noncomputable definition; a prime with zero multiplicity contributes zero.

lemma diffContrib_eq_sum_filter (𝔭 : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F)) :
    diffContrib L 𝔭.asIdeal = ∑ P ∈ (primeSupport (differentIdeal_ne_bot' F L)).filter
      (fun P => primeBelow L P = 𝔭), diffTerm F L P := by
  classical
  haveI := 𝔭.isMaximal
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij_ne_zero (fun P _ _ => P.asIdeal) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro P hP _
    rw [mem_primesOverFinset_iff' 𝔭.ne_bot]
    refine ⟨P.isPrime, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hP).2
    rw [← this]
    rfl
  · intro P _ _ Q _ _ h
    exact HeightOneSpectrum.ext h
  · intro Q hQ hne
    rw [mem_primesOverFinset_iff' 𝔭.ne_bot] at hQ
    obtain ⟨hQp, hQl⟩ := hQ
    have hQ0 : Q ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot 𝔭.ne_bot Q
    let Q' : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L) := ⟨Q, hQp, hQ0⟩
    have hdvd : Q ∣ differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L) := by
      by_contra h
      apply hne
      rw [multiplicity_eq_zero.mpr h]
      simp
    refine ⟨Q', ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_primeSupport]
      refine ⟨hdvd, HeightOneSpectrum.ext ?_⟩
      exact (Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := Q) (p := 𝔭.asIdeal)).symm
    · exact hne
  · intro P _ _
    rfl

readback.en: Let $F,L$ be arbitrary number fields, each with its field and finite-dimensional $\mathbb Q$-vector-space structures, and equip $L$ with an $F$-algebra structure. Write $\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L$ for the rings of integers, $\mathfrak D=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ for the relative different ideal, $d=[L:\mathbb Q]$ for the dimension of the full field $L$, $N(J)=|\mathcal O_L/J|$ for the absolute norm of an ideal of $\mathcal O_L$, and $v_P(\mathfrak D)$ for the natural-number multiplicity of a nonzero prime ideal $P$ in $\mathfrak D$. For a nonzero prime ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $\mathcal O_F$, define $c(\mathfrak p)$ to be the sum of $v_P(\mathfrak D)\log N(P)/d$ over the finite set of prime ideals $P$ of $\mathcal O_L$ lying over $\mathfrak p$, meaning that their inverse image under the induced integer-ring map is $\mathfrak p$; this is the code’s $\operatorname{diffContrib}(L,\mathfrak p)$. For every height-one-spectrum point $\mathfrak p$ of $\mathcal O_F$, $c(\mathfrak p)=\sum_{P\in S,\;P\cap\mathcal O_F=\mathfrak p}\operatorname{diffTerm}(F,L,P)$, where $S$ is the finite set of nonzero prime divisors of $\mathfrak D$ and $\operatorname{diffTerm}(F,L,P)$ is the same real summand $v_P(\mathfrak D)\log N(P)/d$. theorem log_absNorm_differentIdeal_div_eq_finsum :
    Real.log (Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L))) / finrank ℚ L =
      ∑ᶠ 𝔭 : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F), diffContrib L 𝔭.asIdeal := by
  classical
  set s := primeSupport (differentIdeal_ne_bot' F L)
  have hsum : Real.log (Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L))) / finrank ℚ L =
      ∑ P ∈ s, diffTerm F L P := by
    rw [log_absNorm_eq_finsum (differentIdeal_ne_bot' F L), finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      (s := s), Finset.sum_div]
    · rfl
    · intro P hP
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_primeSupport]
      by_contra h
      exact hP (by simp [multiplicity_eq_zero.mpr h])
  rw [hsum, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := s.image (primeBelow (F := F) L))]
  · rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := primeBelow (F := F) L)
      (t := s.image (primeBelow (F := F) L))
      (fun P hP => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hP)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun 𝔭 _ => (diffContrib_eq_sum_filter 𝔭).symm
  · intro 𝔭 h𝔭
    rw [Function.mem_support, diffContrib_eq_sum_filter] at h𝔭
    obtain ⟨P, hP, -⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h𝔭
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hP
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image]
    exact ⟨P, hP.1, hP.2⟩

readback.en: For every natural number $N$, let $\Omega$ be a fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q(T)$ and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ between $\mathbb Q$ and $\Omega$, elements $u,v\in K$, a proof that $u$ is transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, the equation $u^N+v^N=1$, the generation condition $\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$, and a finite-dimensional extension $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ of dimension exactly $N$. Assume $h_{\rm RF}$: for every proper valuation subring $A\subsetneq K$ containing all rational elements, its residue field $\kappa(A)$ is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb Q$. For every $\varphi\in K$ and every point $x=(A,\sigma)$, where $A$ is such a valuation subring and $\sigma:\kappa(A)\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$ is a unital ring homomorphism into the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q$, assume $h_{\rm good}$: $\varphi\in A$ and its residue image $z=\sigma(\overline\varphi)$ is neither $0$ nor $1$. Set $E=\sigma(\kappa(A))\subseteq\overline{\mathbb Q}$ and $B=\mathbb Q(z)$. The image used by the code is this $z$ under $h_{\rm good}$; $E$ is equipped with the finite-dimensional $\mathbb Q$-structure supplied by $h_{\rm RF}$, and its $B$-algebra structure is the actual inclusion $B\hookrightarrow E$. Let $\mathfrak D=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_B,\mathcal O_E)$ and $d=[E:\mathbb Q]$. For every nonzero prime ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $\mathcal O_B$, let $c(\mathfrak p)$ be the finite sum $\sum_{P\mid\mathfrak p}v_P(\mathfrak D)\log N_E(P)/d$ over the prime ideals of $\mathcal O_E$ whose inverse image in $\mathcal O_B$ is $\mathfrak p$, where $v_P$ is natural-number ideal multiplicity and $N_E(J)=|\mathcal O_E/J|$ is the absolute ideal norm; natural numbers in these real expressions are cast to real numbers. Both conclusions hold: $\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}^{(1)}(\mathcal O_B):c(\mathfrak p)\ne0\}$ is finite, and $\log N_E(\mathfrak D)/d=\sum^{\!f}_{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}^{(1)}(\mathcal O_B)}c(\mathfrak p)$, with the algebraic finite-support sum over all nonzero prime ideals of $\mathcal O_B$.
